package cache

import (
	"errors"

	sieve "sieve.client"
)

type Delta struct {
	Type   string
	Object interface{}
}
type sharedIndexInformer struct{ Values []interface{} }

func (s *sharedIndexInformer) HandleDeltas(obj interface{}) error {
	for _, d := range obj.([]Delta) {
		recvID := sieve.NotifyLearnBeforeControllerRecv(string(d.Type), d.Object) //sieve
		if d.Type == "error" {
			return errors.New("bad delta")
		}
		s.Values = append(s.Values, d.Object)
		sieve.NotifyLearnAfterControllerRecv(recvID, string(d.Type), d.Object) //sieve
	}
	return nil
}
